name: two-in-a-room
provenance: Authored 2026-08-30 by The Company. The MECHANISM half of the-orange, split out so the part the world can already do is measured separately from the part it cannot. Its witness is a query, not a pin: at seed 42 the pair that resolves is a wild otyugh and a wild carrion-crawler, because SOC-one-creature-per-settlement makes a settlement hold exactly one derived creature and therefore makes wild concentrations the only place two bodies share a room.

scenes.title: Two creatures share a room, and the possessing will can see what one of them carries

beats.description: someone else is genuinely in this room -- the presence-gated channel, not the world-truth one

and the will can see what that creature is holding. NOTE: this asserts the CHANNEL is there, which is the whole of what a world can currently witness -- no co-located creature in any world found so far is actually holding anything, so the non-empty case is proven only by vessel's own test (a_co_located_creature_reports_what_it_carries_and_reports_an_empty_hand_as_empty) and not by a scene. That gap is a finding, not an oversight.
